title: DongA Ilbo: SK Hynix gained ~$15B on its Kioxia stake earlier in 2026, and plans to return ~$12B to shareholders via a special dividend (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: DongA Ilbo: SK Hynix gained ~$15B on its Kioxia stake earlier in 2026, and plans to return ~$12B to shareholders via a special dividend — SK Hynix Inc.'s shares bucked a broad selloff in AI-related stocks thanks to the prospect of a hefty dividend payout related to the South Korean memory maker's stake …
